name: Sailor Locust
description: A tamed locust that takes the helm of any boat and sails it between named docks: along buoys you place, or along the shortest water route it works out by itself, with a timetable that repeats. No world map needed. Inspired by the Conductor Locust of Yang's Transport Tycoon and by Boat Autopilot (Majke); it shares no code and no assets with either.
